{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Refunded orders found:", len(refunded))

# Confirm: only two channels
print("Channels present:", df['channel'].unique())"}
